name: linkkwork-monorepo
description: LinkkWork Enterprise Monorepo - Web Admin, Backend API and Mobile App Suite

scripts.mobile:lint: cd apps/mobile && export PATH="$HOME/development/flutter/bin:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH" && melos run lint --no-select
scripts.mobile:typecheck: cd apps/mobile && export PATH="$HOME/development/flutter/bin:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH" && melos run typecheck --no-select
scripts.mobile:format: cd apps/mobile && export PATH="$HOME/development/flutter/bin:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH" && melos run format --no-select
scripts.mobile:format:check: cd apps/mobile && export PATH="$HOME/development/flutter/bin:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH" && melos run format:check --no-select
scripts.mobile:test: cd apps/mobile && export PATH="$HOME/development/flutter/bin:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH" && melos run test --no-select
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/admin test && npm run mobile:test
